{{Quote|The patrol ships were being refurbished at our base on Morr Three.|[[Keta]], member of the Cavrilhu Pirates|<ref name="TTTS" />}}
The terrestrial celestial body '''Morr Three'''<ref name="TTTS" /> was located in the [[Amorris system/Legends|Amorris system]],<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Email" /> a part of the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA Amorris" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was site of a base operated by the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]], who carried out raids in the Amorris [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] used the base for the refurbishment of their [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="TTTS" />

After the Cavrilhu Pirates had raided a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] convoy during the [[Thrawn campaign]],<ref name="TTTS" /> they brought three [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]]s<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|112|Cavrllhu pirates}}</ref> they had stolen to Morr Three to be refurbished. The starship [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Niles Ferrier]] subsequently arrived at the base with a shipment of [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]] that he claimed had been requested by the pirate [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zothip]]. In reality, the delivery was merely a ploy that gave Ferrier the opportunity to steal the Cavrilhu Pirates' patrol ships.<ref name="TTTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morr Three was first mentioned in [[West End Games]]' ''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and published in [[1992]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="DFRS">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Email" /> the co-author of the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> confirmed during the development of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to that book that Morr Three was located in the Amorris system,<ref name="Email" /> which ''The Essential Atlas'' placed in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA Amorris" />
